limitations: One eta bin and adaptive adjacent pt merging based only on MC effective statistics.
DY/WJets pooling is an explicit vector-boson-plus-jets hypothesis; sparse standalone WJets estimates retained for comparison.
Uncertainty is weighted per-jet delta-method only, omitting event/block correlations.
No SF extrapolation prescribed; this is an efficiency map, not permission to extend SF coverage.
Candidate maps are not enabled in Stage1.
provenance: Frozen candidate map from XZZ control synchronization iteration015; central conventions validated in full iteration017. Calibration/map uncertainties are not included.
